component.name: DS·IDE
component.summary: An agentic desktop IDE for DeepSeek

description.p: DS·IDE is a local-first agentic IDE on Tauri: a chat partner that runs tools on your own machine — reading and writing files, running commands you allow, searching the web — next to a work area with a file tree, diffs, a terminal and a preview.

It works with DeepSeek models over an OpenAI-compatible API. The key is kept in the system keyring, never in the interface. The companion chooses its own name once, and everything it remembers stays on this machine.
